KB-C1.name: Quillen finite generation and canonical K-theory model
KB-C1.statement_used: For every number field L, K_i(O_L) is finitely generated for all i>=0. The standard Quillen K-groups for i>=1 are pi_i(BGL_infinity(O_L)^+).
KB-C1.source: D. Quillen, Finite generation of the groups K_i of rings of algebraic integers, LNM341 (1973),179-198,Theorem1; canonical plus/exact-category comparison in Quillen K-theory, also Arlettaz Definition3.12 and Remark3.16.
KB-C1.matching: O_L is the full ring of integers, m=2e>=2. Finite generation at m-1 is also used for the finite-coefficient inverse limit. Only the canonical model is chosen; no universal assertion for arbitrary source Plus records is inferred.

KB-C2.name: Borel even-degree rank zero
KB-C2.statement_used: For number fields and i>=2, rank K_i(O_L) is 0,r1+r2,0,r2 according to i mod4=0,1,2,3; only the even zero cases are used.
KB-C2.source: A. Borel, Stable real cohomology of arithmetic groups, Ann.Sci.ENS7(1974),235-272,Proposition12.2,p.271.
KB-C2.matching: Set D=k=L in the proposition for orders in central division algebras, and the order to O_L. Together with KB-C1 gives finiteness, not merely torsion.

KB-C3.kind: named classical citation leaf, matched in finite coefficients
KB-C3.name: Dwyer-Friedlander finite coefficient comparison and etale spectral sequence
KB-C3.statement_used: For a field of ell-cohomological dimension at most2, or its ring of S-integers, finite-coefficient algebraic-to-etale K comparison is onto in degrees>=2; for ell2 use r>=2 and a primitive fourth root. Localizing at ell does not change these algebraic K groups with finite ell-power coefficients in degrees>=2. The finite etale spectral sequence has E2^{p,-q}=H^p_et(U,Z/ell^r(q/2)), even q, converging to K_{q-p}^et.
KB-C3.source: W.G.Dwyer and E.M.Friedlander, Algebraic and etale K-theory, Trans.AMS292(1985),247-280,Propositions5.2,8.1,8.2 and Theorem8.5; completed conclusion Theorem8.7 and Remark8.8.
KB-C3.matching: Total complexness supplies finite ell-cd through LD3; HasMuQ supplies integral primitive fourth root at ell2. The proof handles m2 explicitly with finite comparison, avoiding any OCR ambiguity in Theorem8.7. Cofinal r>=2 at ell2. Compatible maps pass through exact finite systems, with all limit arguments given in KB1-2.

KB-C4.name: Finite etale/Galois comparison and finiteness
KB-C4.statement_used: For U=Spec O_L[1/ell], locally constant finite ell-primary sheaves have G_S cohomology equal to etale cohomology and all finite-level groups are finite.
KB-C4.source: J.S.Milne, Arithmetic Duality Theorems,2nded(2006),II Proposition2.9 and Theorem2.13. Global higher vanishing is already LD3 (I Theorem4.10).
KB-C4.matching: ell is invertible on U. The original closed-inertia quotient is pi1(U); original D.chi is the uniquely descended cyclotomic character. The compact integral comparison is proved here, not included in this finite theorem.

KB-C5.name: Van der Kallen integral homology stability
KB-C5.statement_used: With stable dimension d and a>=2m+max(1,d), H_m(GL_a(R),Z)->H_m(GL_{a+1}(R),Z) is an isomorphism.
KB-C5.source: W.van der Kallen, Homology stability for linear groups,Invent.Math.60(1980),269-295,Convention2.2 and Theorem4.11,p.289.
KB-C5.matching: KB3 proves source StableRangeLe O_L2 by CRT, which is SR3 and permits d=1 in Convention2.2. The actual block inclusions at a>=N=2m+4 are well within the integral range. Bar homology commuting with filtered unions is proved.

KB-C6.name: Arlettaz integral Hurewicz kernel bound
KB-C6.statement_used: For any ring and m>=2, R_m kills the kernel of K_m(R)->H_m(GL_infinity(R),Z), where R_m=product_{a=2}^m L_a and L_a is squarefree.
KB-C6.source: D.Arlettaz, Algebraic K-theory of rings from a topological viewpoint,PublicacionsMatematiques44(2000),3-84,Definitions7.11,7.14 and Corollary7.19(a),pp.52-55.
KB-C6.matching: Target is GL, not E. Source ArlAdm/arlL/arlR agree after zero-versus-one sequence reindexing; cutoff p<=a loses no prime, L1=1. Flat base change preserves kernel, v_ell R_m<=m-1<=cOne(m), unit part invertible. No omitted small primes.

KB-C7.name: Unramified global Artin reciprocity
KB-C7.statement_used: The Galois group of the maximal abelian extension of L unramified at all places is the ordinary ideal class group.
